rules.book: ticks.bid and ticks.ask in stored cents, carried between book observations; missing sides remain null.
rules.change_point: Every native timestamp where any of the six fields changes; no minute rounding and no synthetic formation tick. Equal-timestamp conflicts exclude the leg instead of imposing ingestion order.
rules.event_date: The event_id's YYMMMDD calendar label, distinct from bell_utc_date; same-day retrieval hygiene must use the same basis for old and new libraries.
rules.excluded_inferred_source: book_transition is a changed-last surrogate, not a true trade; never authors low/high/last/volume.
rules.floor_fraction: First accepted true print at the eventual post-formation minimum, on this leg's formation-to-bell clock. No future path labels are inserted into causal points.
rules.high: Running maximum of accepted prints.price from formation; never ticks.last or book_transition.
rules.last: Most recent accepted prints.price at or before native timestamp; no midpoint, anchor, or ticks.last fallback.
rules.leave_self_out: Not applied while cutting; scoreboard applies walk-forward, leave-self-out and same-day exclusion.
rules.low: Running minimum of accepted prints.price initialized through formation, identical to ORDER 1's prior-low convention; subsequent true prints update it.
rules.pair_hygiene: Only events with exactly two successful bounded legs emitted; incomplete pairs excluded and counted.
rules.roles: Only src_role != TUNE_SAMPLE; NULL src_role is excluded rather than inferred from name.
rules.side: LEADER if inherited filed post-formation anchor_cents >= 50, otherwise UNDERDOG. The scoreboard's first-tick pair anchors are a separate causal read.
rules.span: File W1_GROUND_TRUTH_TABLE schema only; verified_span=OK and known bell_source; per-leg formation_end_epoch <= ts < bell_epoch; no bell or formation inference. The literal bell endpoint is used; filed_span_end_epoch is disclosed separately.
rules.volume: Running sum of accepted prints.size at formation <= ts < bell; missing/negative sizes exclude the leg. Stored zero sizes remain zero and are not estimated.
